required_outcomes: Links the new fault to R-4650: East London Appliance Repairs replaced the left oven door hinge and seal on 14 August 2026 with parts and workmanship guaranteed for 90 days, so today (10 October, day 57) the same hinge failing is inside the guarantee.

Logs the repair for T-1003 (Flat 9, 3 Amhurst Road) as a routine appliance job referencing R-4650: oven door hinge broken again, the door hangs open and won't shut, access weekday mornings, has a cat. Resolves or updates E-4901 once the job exists.
Sends it back to East London Appliance Repairs as a guarantee recall at no charge (assigning them and telling them it is under the R-4650 guarantee), rather than a new chargeable job.
Tells the tenant the repair is logged with the reference and that the original contractor is coming back under guarantee.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking East London Appliance Repairs to confirm the recall and a weekday-morning slot before booking, if the request is sent now.
Telling the landlord, Daniel Price, that the hinge has failed again and is being fixed under guarantee at no cost to him.
positive_behaviours: Notes that a repeat failure eight weeks on is worth flagging to the landlord in case the oven needs more than another hinge.
Leaves the unrelated closed jobs R-4402 and R-4521 alone.
red_flags: Treats it as a brand-new chargeable repair with no reference to R-4650.
Sends a different contractor, which would void the guarantee.
prohibited_actions: Escalating a routine guarantee recall to a human.
Leaving the tenant without a ticket or any follow-up, as if E-4901 were handled.
critical_failures: No repair logged and no contact with the tenant.
